cards.text:
The live lobby view shows Iselle spinning before the Tower gate and
snapping her cap straight.

cards.speaker: Iselle
cards.text:
Floor Two cleared! The upper beacon is relit; the account gained 5 Gold and
1 Building Resource, bringing it to 49 Gold and 5 Building Resources. Floor
Three is unlocked, and stamina is down to 3/5.

cards.speaker: Iselle
cards.text:
Now choose: buy one basic summon for 2 Gold, or send Renna Holt and
Mirelle Voss back through the gate for Floor Three. Which risk gets the next
turn, Master?
